summary: Belite Bio, Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report the completion of its rolling submission of a New Drug Application (NDA) to the U.S. FDA for tinlarebant, an investigational oral therapy for Stargardt disease type 1. The NDA was submitted under Breakthrough Therapy Designation. No financial terms, consideration, or merger-related mechanics are involved. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report of business progress. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations event. What to watch: FDA acceptance and PDUFA date assignment, but no risk-arb angle exists.
